explication: OAuth 2.0 Client is a PHP runtime library for integrating applications with authorization servers. A user or application requests an authorization URL, completes consent, and exchanges the returned grant for an access token. The provider orchestrates grant validation, request construction, HTTP exchange, token parsing, authenticated resource calls, and resource-owner creation. GenericProvider supplies configurable endpoints and bearer authentication; the library also supports refresh, password, client-credentials, PKCE, and pluggable provider clients. Excerpts limit some exact collaborator wiring.
